skill.name: use-skills
skill.description: Selects a focused working set of installed skills for multi-domain requests and shows the chosen mode before answering.
skill.summary: Coordinates relevant skills so complex AI requests use the right guidance.
skill.author: CyrusSE

security_audit.summary: All static external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline backticks and fenced text examples in SKILL.md. The two blocker findings are false positives on quality-check prose, and no prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

content.value_statement: Complex requests often span planning, writing, review, and implementation. This skill selects relevant installed skills and presents a concise working set.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the user to choose All related, Recommended, or Restricted mode when needed.
Labels candidate skills as primary, support, or skip during selection.
Builds a compact response block with mode, selected skills, and purpose.
Guides agents to avoid file reads before a required mode choice.
Defines quality checks for focused, non-duplicative skill use.
limitations: It depends on the visible installed skill list in the current session.
It does not install, update, or discover unavailable skills.
It can add an extra mode-selection step before work begins.
It does not provide domain expertise without other selected skills.

use_cases.title: Plan cross-functional work
use_cases.description: Select skills for requests that combine strategy, implementation, documentation, and review.

use_cases.title: Combine implementation and review
use_cases.description: Choose focused skills for feature work that needs coding guidance and testing checks.

use_cases.title: Structure documentation tasks
use_cases.description: Route documentation rewrites through writing, structure, and technical review guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a balanced set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a known task.
prompt_templates.prompt: $use-skills Recommended. Help me choose the right skills for this task: [task].

prompt_templates.title: Keep selection focused
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused work where only the strongest skills should shape the answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: $use-skills Restricted. Use only the strongest skills to plan this work: [goal and constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Review broadly
prompt_templates.scenario: Broad request that may need planning, writing, testing, and implementation support.
prompt_templates.prompt: $use-skills All related. Review this request across planning, implementation, writing, and testing concerns: [request].

prompt_templates.title: Resolve skill conflicts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task where multiple skills may give different guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: $use-skills Recommended. Build a working set for [project]. Explain conflicts only when they affect the final answer.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a feature implementation plan with testing notes.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects planning and testing skills, shows a short mode block, and returns one unified plan.

output_examples.input: A user asks to rewrite a README and improve its structure.
output_examples.output: The assistant chooses writing and documentation guidance, then produces a clearer README outline and revision notes.

output_examples.input: A user invokes the skill without choosing a mode.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for All related, Recommended, or Restricted mode before doing workspace exploration.

best_practices: Name a mode when you already know the desired breadth.
Provide the task goal and expected output before requesting skill selection.
Use Restricted mode when speed and focus matter more than broad coverage.
anti_patterns: Use the skill for a simple task that one domain skill can handle.
Ask it to invent skills that are not visible in the session.
Ignore the mode gate after invoking the skill without a mode.

faq.question: Does this skill install other skills?
faq.answer: No. It only helps choose from skills that are visible or provided in the current session.

faq.question: Which modes does it support?
faq.answer: It supports All related, Recommended, and Restricted modes for different coverage levels.

faq.question: When should I use Recommended mode?
faq.answer: Use Recommended mode when you want a balanced working set without unnecessary skill involvement.

faq.question: Can it use skills not shown in the session?
faq.answer: No. It should use visible skill metadata or skill details provided by the user.

faq.question: Does it replace domain skills?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates domain skills and helps decide which guidance should shape the answer.

faq.question: Why does it ask for a mode?
faq.answer: The mode controls how broad the selected working set should be before the main task begins.
